description: Autocomplete an address/place from partial text using Radar. Returns ranked address/place suggestions with coordinates. Optionally bias results near a lat,lng. Example: radar_autocomplete({ query: "841 broadway new", near: "40.73,-73.99", _apiKey: "prj_live_sk_..." })

_apiKey.description: Radar API key (get one free at radar.com). Looks like prj_live_sk_... or prj_live_pk_...

query.description: Partial address or place name, e.g. "841 broadway new"

name: radar_autocomplete
title: Radar Autocomplete
